# Pull request — 1.0.0

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)
## Summary

Describe what changes and why.

## Security boundary

Explain whether the change affects encryption, KEK custody, sessions, MFA, backup, or restoration.

## Verification

- [ ] Appropriate tests completed, with exact commands and observed results.
- [ ] No secrets, credential artifacts, vault data or private backups committed.
- [ ] English and Vietnamese documentation updated together.
- [ ] Bilingual documentation validator passes.
- [ ] No unverified production deployment claims introduced.

## Evidence

Record reproducible test details and link to CI runs. Do not upload confidential evidence.
